events.text: Ammo. I don't have a gun yet, but ammo.
Nobody painted that. Which means I MUST touch it.
Hold on. Is there an easier way to that collectible?
I can make that. Probably. LOOT!
Remember this ledge. Remember this ledge.

profile.intro: Loot goblin. Wanders off to explore everything and won't leave a single shiny thing behind.
